Aisha: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. We need owners + dates for remediation items; theres a 2x recurrence in the last month.

Tom: I can own the alert tuning and pager thresholds. Will open a Jira and aim for a PR with tests by 2025-05-12.

OncallBot: Created ticket RDX-4555: "Alert tuning for noisy leader-election alerts" assigned to Tom. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDX-4555

Ravi: I'll take the runbook clean-up and add explicit do-not-escalate windows for flapping. ETA: 2025-05-15.

Aisha: Please add a RACI block in the ticket: R=Tom, A=Aisha, C=Ravi, I=platform-oncall. Also add recurrence_count=2 and link the resilience epic RDX-4010.

Tom: RDX-4555 updated with RACI and links. Quick note: prefer to keep alert tuning and runbook as subtasks to avoid scope creep.

Ravi: Agreed. I'll create RDX-4555-1 (runbook) and RDX-4555-2 (chaos test).

Aisha: Process decision: tickets for postmortem remediations created within 48h, owner assigned within 72h, and canary plan attached before rollout. I'll schedule a monthly recurrence review meeting.

OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: "Postmortem recurrence review" 2025-05-20, attendees: SRE, TestInfra, PMs.

Tom: Action recap copied to ticket: Tom (R) alert tuning due 2025-05-12; Ravi (R) runbook & chaos tests due 2025-05-15; Aisha (A) sign-off by 2025-05-20.

Aisha: Thanks — keep updates on RDX-4555 and ping this thread for blockers. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
